hypotheses.F1_hybrid_behavioral_fidelity: Hybrid-64 has median native-to-replacement KL at most 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F2_hybrid_ce_fidelity: Hybrid-64 increases answer cross-entropy by at most 0.01 nats on every corpus.
hypotheses.F3_state64_behavioral_fidelity: State-SVD-64 has median KL at most 0.02 and CE increase at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F4_hybrid_improves_specialists: Hybrid-64 has lower median KL than both semantic-32 and state-SVD-64 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F5_random_control_fails: Random-64 median KL is at least ten times hybrid-64 KL on every corpus.
